seeded-volume.initializeCommand: docker run --rm -v claude-data:/v alpine sh -c "touch /v/.seed && echo '{\"seeded\":true}' >/v/claude.json && chown $(id -u):$(id -g) /v"

other-user.initializeCommand: docker run --rm -v claude-data:/v alpine sh -c "touch /v/.root-owned /v/.other-owned && chown 4242 /v/.other-owned && chmod 600 /v/.other-owned && chown $(id -u):$(id -g) /v"
